title: 29 Marian Crescent, Rathfarnham, Dublin 14, D14R9V6
description:
-Large 4 Bedroomed Semi-Detached Family Home

-Very Large South-East Facing Rear Garden

-Off Street Parking For Multiple Cars With Brick Paved Driveway

-Wonderfully Quiet Residential Location

-Plenty Of Scope For Enlargement

Premium Collection are delighted to present this wonderfully spacious 4 bedroom semi-detached family home in the quiet residential setting of Marian Crescent in highly sought-after Rathfarnham.

Enjoying a large south east facing rear garden and converted garage, this home offers an excellent opportunity for families seeking space, privacy and the potential to create a truly special home.

The accommodation provides four well-proportioned bedrooms with ample flexibility for an additional home office, playroom or extra guest accommodation if required.

Upon entering the spacious hall through an porch entrance, immediately to the left is a very large light and bright livingroom with two large front windows and a large feature fireplace. To the right is a good sized kitchen/dining room with plenty of country style cabinetry and a large south facing window that invites plenty of natural light into the space. Off the kitchen is a converted garage which serves to provide a room that is ideal for a home office/playroom or guest room together with a good sized storage room and downstairs bathroom. Completing the downstairs area is a separate spacious study/TV room which looks out over the back garden.

Upstairs comprises 4 spacious bedrooms off a central landing with a good sized main bathroom with shower and floor to ceiling tile. There is also extra storage in the newly floored and insulated attic.

The rear garden is a particularly special feature of this home. Very large and private, it has a south east facing aspect with mature trees and is accessed from the front through a side gate. There is plenty of parking to the front with a large brick paved driveway and the home has excellent curb appeal in a quiet residential setting. 

The energy bills for this home are significantly reduced also as a result of the recently installed solar energy system in the roof and there is extra security provided by a new alarm and cctv system.

With both the Rathfarnham Shopping Centre and Rathfarnham village nearby this home enjoys a very convenient location with a wide range of primary and secondary schools to choose from along with créches and restaurants being just a short stroll away. Situated at the foot of the Dublin Mountains and close to the Dodder River this location is ideal for those that enjoy the outdoors and the home's proximity to an abundance of sporting facilities ensure as active a lifestyle that anyone could strive for. There are also excellent transport links to the city centre (15B) and the M50 is only a 5-minute drive away. 

To get a true sense of what this home has to offer, viewing is highly recommended.
